note: C6.19 BR-6 (P-419, P-170): expiry rules for facts brought from an earlier case, as data (P-425: no combination key or program branch in engine code). Each rule names the fact holding the date, what it checks, the facts it covers (all flagged with it) and its source: canada.ca page, quote and the date our copy was recorded, or Sample with the reason (ASSUMPTIONS.md). kind: expires_before_today (the date is before today), expires_within_months (the date is before today plus months), issued_more_than_months_ago (the date is before today minus months). blocks: true means a flagged value cannot be re-confirmed (the person enters the new document); false is a warning only.
